summary: Frontend-only verification for bilingual verb-learning Expo app. Both Spanish bug fixes verified as WORKING and English regression PASSES. BUG1: In Spanish mode, subject carousel on M1.A shows exactly [Yo, Tú, Él, Ella, Nosotros, Ellos] with NO 'Ello'. BUG2: On M1.A and M1.B in Spanish mode, auxiliary carousel shows Spanish labels [Puedo, Podría, Querría, Debería, Puedo, Podría, Debo, Voy a] with no English words. Regression: ES M1.A default cards render 'Yo puedo cortar.', 'Yo no puedo cortar.', '¿Puedo yo cortar?'. English mode still defaults on fresh load: subject 'I', aux carousel starts with 'Can', affirmative card 'I can cut.'.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Not blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:123 and other style sheets using shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking, likely inside a library component.

action_items: Optional: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow (RN new architecture) to silence deprecation warnings.
Optional: replace props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents where applicable.
critical_code_review_comments: SUBJECTS_ES in /app/frontend/src/data/conjugation_es.ts correctly contains only 6 entries (Yo, Tú, Él, Ella, Nosotros, Ellos) — 'Ello' removed as required.
AUX_OPTIONS_ES in /app/frontend/src/data/conjugation_es.ts provides Spanish labels while keeping the same keys (Can/Could/...) so builders and English side keep working — clean design.
PERSON_ES mapping still supports Él and Ella both to index 2, consistent with the removed 'Ello'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Language state is client-side context. To test Spanish, switch within same session via menu-button -> lang-spanish, then tap module-M1.A / module-M1.B. Note: UI language is inverse of learn language (learn=en shows Spanish UI headers like 'AFIRMATIVA', learn=es shows English UI headers like 'AFFIRMATIVE'). This is by design.
rca_of_issue: N/A — both fixes verified as effective.
